main_text.l: ܢܘܒ ܕܥܘܫ Syr. Naufragium, ܠܥܘܫ ܕܥܘܫ Λ ܘܣ
Fui in naufragio. Ex Græco ναυαγία, 2.ad Cor.11.25.
נוך Ch.& Syr. Vagari, errare, migrare, moveri, agi-
tari. Aphel אניר Movere, commovere, agitare. De-
inde quoq; eft Condolere, ut Hebraicè. Unde Pahel
Præter. וַיָּנִידוּ לִיהּ Et Condoluerunt ipsi, Jobi 42.11.
נודא נור Ch. Uter, Jud.4.19.
נוח נית Chald.& Syr. Quiescere, Requiescere, Quiescere
te se continere: Aphel אניח Quiescere, requiesce-
re, cessare fecit, Requiem, quietem attulit, dedit vel
largitus est: Refecit, refocillavit: Item Relinquere,
Missum facere, ܕܫܝܘܢ Relinquamus er-
go, Sic in Viennensi. In Regiis est ܢܝܚܘܢ Propella-
mus, ad Rom.13.12. Ethpeh. ܢܝܚܐ Quiescere, re-
quiescere: Refici, refocillari: Ch. נתנח Quiescet, ha-
bitabit, cum ܐ ab initio & duplici ת, more Syro. Pro-
ܢܘܚܐ Syr. Quies, Tranquillitas, Marc.4.39.
ניחא, ניחא Chald. & Syr. Quies, Requies, tranquillitas,
בניחא, Facile, leniter, quiete, lente, placide, tranquil-
le, Genes.33.14. in Jon.
ܢܝܚܐ Syr. Idem, Act.3.20. & 7.49.
ניח ניחא Chald. Idem. בניח, Idem quod בניחא. Sic &
בניחותא, ניחותא. Plur. emph. מי ניחיא Aquæ quietis,
id est, tranquillæ, Psal.23.2.
מנח Ch. Idem: Item Aura, Genes.3.8.
מנחא Ch.Idem, בית מנחיכי In domum quietis tuę, Psal.

page.notes: Hebrew, Syriac and Greek script in several entries is reproduced approximately; the exact vocalisation and diacritics in the Hebrew and Syriac forms could not be read with certainty. Marked uncertain: the Syriac and Hebrew forms in the first lines and the Aphel/Ethpeh forms.
